title: German group files criminal complaint over Meta AI smart glasses
summary: HateAid filed a complaint against Meta, EssilorLuxottica units and retailers, arguing Ray-Ban Meta glasses are illegal covert recording devices.
reason: Civil-society challenge to AI wearable surveillance.

title: Gemini app reaches 1 billion monthly users
summary: Google said the Gemini app passed one billion monthly users; ChatGPT reportedly reached a similar scale.

title: Reported AI-agent cyberattack on Taiwan's nuclear regulator
summary: Roundups citing Reuters said a China-linked actor used autonomous AI agents for reconnaissance and intrusion attempts against Taiwan's nuclear safety regulator; not independently verified here.
reason: State-linked AI-enabled cyberattack on critical infrastructure; sourcing unverified so D.
